gpu_accounting_policy: Count one allocated hour on any allowed GPU as one hour of the shared 24-hour cap; this is wall-time accounting, not A100-equivalent work or billing.
planning_budget: 10-minute GPU preflight + two 55-minute generation caps + 20-minute conditional AF3 cap = 2h20 maximum.
nomination_policy: Retain sequence-verified poses without score or geometry cutoffs. For the one AF3 slot, prefer sequence refolds, then scored backbones, then early-stopped backbones. Within each group prioritize proximity to both cleavage-bond atoms, then iPTM.
model_uncertainty: AFDB stalk pLDDT ~33–40. Psi490 perturbations are sensitivity models, not experimentally observed or equilibrium conformers.
